artworks.label: Peach stone seedling
artworks.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. ONE new original standalone square1024x1024 Glaze small-widget illustration for peachskin. One beautiful germinating peach stone, warm cinnamon-brown deeply textured split pit cradling a small ivory kernel, slender new green shoot rising with two soft young leaves and one delicate curved root below. Fine-art natural botanical macro photography, realistic stone ridges, tender translucent leaves, softly luminous warm peach/cream/muted-green palette and gentle diffuse daylight. No whole peach, peach slice, blossom, teacup or cloth. Whole subject centered, compact readable silhouette, generous18percent empty margins. Truly transparent empty background, alpha preserved; no opaque tile, floor, frame, border or collage. Pure illustration only: absolutely no text, lettering, numerals, dates, clocks, hands, dials, calendars, UI, logos or watermark. Entirely new art, never copy/crop/recolour an existing image.
artworks.processing: Resize entire original square to 1024x1024; WebP q90 method4; alpha preserved; no crop, recolour or subject edits.
artworks.visualReview: Reviewed against wallpaper and all current pure-art subjects; distinct subject, matching style/palette, no text or live-value imagery.
